meta.method: Read named 2011 sources; one point per (source, location); Nominatim geocode inside AOI bbox, 1 req/s; manual neighbourhood centre only if Nominatim missed or matched the wrong district. Wayback not required for live pages.
meta.notes: Quotes are verbatim excerpts ≤ 25 words. Ibadan death figures on ReliefWeb omitted (not Lagos). Katsina deaths on Solar Daily/AFP omitted. IFRC Denro/Akute/Alagbole omitted (Ogun outskirts). Allen Avenue deaths are generator fumes after rain, not drowning. Ajegunle, Ajeromi (28 families) kept separate from Ajegunle, Ikorodu. Vanguard 12 Jul marks the Alagbado wall death unconfirmed; 15 Jul reports a fence death in Akera, Alagbado. News Ghana is a 2012 recall of 10 July 2011. No locations, times, numbers or quotes were inferred beyond the text.
omitted: Ibadan / Oyo deaths (ReliefWeb Gov't of Nigeria 30 Aug 2011)
Katsina nine deaths (AFP via Solar Daily)
Denro, Akute, Alagbole bridge (IFRC; outskirts of Lagos State)
ThisDay 15 Jul 2011 (cited in papers; page not readable)

review.notes: Geocoding spot-checked (two Ajegunles distinct; Lekki = peninsula). Quotes verified verbatim for Vanguard, Al Jazeera, AFP/Solar Daily; IFRC/ReliefWeb and News Ghana unverifiable from here. IFRC "started about 5 a.m." is consistent with IMERG (Ikeja 6.7 mm/h at 05:00) but unverified.
